title: Days of the Week
label: ch:hi-days-of-the-week
canDo: I can name all seven days of the week in Hindi and say which planet each day is named for.

payoff.summary: Recite सोमवार through रविवार end to end, name each day's deity and the Babylonian sky behind the whole planet-week, and close it with Saturn's day and the Sun's day.
payoff.note: HI-C10-shanivaar-ravivaar now recalls the deity + vār pattern and the shared Babylonian/Hellenistic origin taught by HI-C10-somavaar-shukravaar as well as its own two days: 4 of the chapter's 6 atoms. The two one-character recognition segments (HI-S05-sign-virama, HI-S114-letter-ha, sequence 545-546) come after the payoff in reading order, so they stay out of it; they belong to the script strand's own ramp.
